blindedResponses.result: Public detail, comment-create, and vote responses now exclude blinded posts and comments before response shaping.

anonymousIds.result: Community mutation routes accept a browser-provided anonymousId. Writes remain launch-gated; a server-bound identity design is required before enabling those routes.
anonymousIds.decision: Do not enable community writes until a server-bound anonymous session or member identity replaces raw client authority.

authEnumeration.result: Password recovery uses generic public responses, hashed recovery codes, and rate limits.

adminBootstrap.result: Production does not register the legacy set-admin route.

cloudinaryPrivateData.result: The existing upload path returns public Cloudinary identifiers and delivery URLs. It is not a private note or private photo store.
cloudinaryPrivateData.decision: Keep private notes/photos out of this path; require a separate access-controlled storage design before adding them.
